title: Travelling Alone in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Choose one part of Berlin first.** Alexanderplatz and Museum Island suit a historic-centre day, Tiergarten suits a quieter day, and Kottbusser Tor works when you want Kreuzberg street life rather than a checklist.
**Give the middle of the day to one place.** Enter one museum, sit in a park or stop for food before deciding whether to move again.
**Check the live connection before moving.** BVG service, construction and night transport patterns can change, so use the official connection search shortly before you leave each place.

**Use a tour when conversation is the missing piece.** My walking tour, Berlin Then and Now, starts at 12:30 at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz and lasts about 2.5 hours through the historic centre of former East Berlin. A walk needs at least 2 guests.
Use the Berlin Solo Day Path to choose a real start, one proper stop and a nearby finish.
